title: Halogen anion pre-homogenization of sequentially deposited wide bandgap perovskites for commercial textured perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,6297-6306
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE00563A, Paper
Biao Shi, Pengfei Liu, Zetong Sunli, Wei Han, Cong Sun, Ying Liu, Yuan Luo, Jin Si, Pengcheng Du, Fu Zhang, Miao Yang, Yongcai He, Bo He, Dekun Zhang, Xiaona Du, Xixiang Xu, Rui Xia, Xueling Zhang, Yifeng Chen, Jifan Gao, Ying Zhao, Xiaodan Zhang
A halogen pre-homogenizing approach enables a perovskite/Si tandem module of 64.64 cm2 achieving a photoelectric conversion efficiency of 27.1%.
